subject: Coordination: involuntary exit & severance logistics for Samir Rao
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Immediate offboarding coordination: Samir Rao

Team — following our 8:30 sync with People Ops and legal, leadership has approved an involuntary separation for Samir Rao effective end of day Friday (2026-02-20). I need HR and IT to coordinate logistics so the termination is secure and compliant. Action items I need covered: 

- Neha: please confirm final severance offer, any release/NDAs, and payroll timing. I attached a draft termination notice and the proposed severance terms for review.
- Vivek: plan for access cutoff (Okta, Gmail, AWS) timed to the termination meeting; advise on whether we revoke laptop VPN before or after the meeting.
- Jordan: will you run a quick review for any sensitive resources Samir still has elevated access to (prod keys, customer data)?
- Michael: loop in legal if there are any contract risks; we need confirmation on wording for confidentiality and return-of-property clauses.

I will conduct the termination meeting on Friday 2026-02-20 at 10:00 AM PST (in person + Zoom). Please confirm availability for the times below and any changes to the severance draft. I will not include Samir on this thread.

Attachments: draft_termination_notice_samir.pdf, asset_inventory_samir.xlsx

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Immediate offboarding coordination: Samir Rao

Thanks Ava — acknowledged. I reviewed the draft and attached suggested edits to the severance_terms_samir_20260218.docx (high level changes: 8 weeks pay, standard release language, benefits continuation details + COBRA notice). A few questions: 

1) Final pay period end date? (I assume 2026-02-20)
2) Are we offering outplacement support? If so, I'll include provider details and link in the DocuSign packet.
3) Please confirm whether we want IT to disable remote login immediately after the meeting or schedule a hard cut at 10:30 AM PST.

I'll engage payroll/vendor (payroll@paycorp.com) after you confirm the final terms. I also attached a preliminary checklist for equipment retrieval and a proposed DocuSign envelope to collect the release.

Attachments: severance_terms_samir_20260218.docx

--
Neha Kapoor
People Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Feb 2026 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Immediate offboarding coordination: Samir Rao

Confirmed. IT will: 
- Prepare to suspend Okta and Gmail access at 10:30 AM PST on 2026-02-20 unless you request immediate revocation during the meeting.
- Take image of company laptop and back up local managers' shared drives before disabling device. Please confirm asset tags (I used the attached inventory but need serials).
- Disable AWS console keys and rotate any service credentials Samir owns; I will schedule rotation windows and update infra on-call.

Quick ask: if you prefer an immediate remote lock (pre-meeting), say the word. Otherwise we'll do coordinated cut at 10:30 so the manager can finish the call.

Attachments: asset_inventory_samir.xlsx

Thanks,
Vivek
Senior Systems Engineer — Infra
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Counsel <counsel@employmentlawfirm.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Feb 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Immediate offboarding coordination: Samir Rao

Neha / Michael — thanks for the heads up. Quick notes from counsel: 
- The proposed 8-week severance is reasonable; include explicit waiver of claims in the DocuSign release.
- Add a paragraph clarifying continuation of health benefits and COBRA steps to avoid misunderstandings.
- For roles with access to customer data, consider a short garden-leave payment window if you anticipate any risk; otherwise the standard immediate separation plus access revocation is acceptable.

I'll circulate a redlined release by EOD for your review. If you want, I can join a 15-minute pre-termination call to confirm wording live.

Best,
Lisa Turner
Employment Counsel
counsel@employmentlawfirm.com
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Feb 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Immediate offboarding coordination: Samir Rao

Confirmed — termination meeting scheduled for Friday 2026-02-20 at 10:00 AM PST (Conference Room B + Zoom). Plan below: 

- 10:00 AM: Manager (Ava) conducts meeting, reads termination and severance summary. HR (Neha) will be on the call to present the release and next steps.
- 10:15 AM: Samir signs release via DocuSign if he agrees; otherwise HR will record refusal and next steps. Link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC1234xyz
- 10:30 AM: IT to suspend Okta/Gmail and revoke AWS credentials. IT to collect laptop after meeting (on-site pickup) and will image the device.

Neha: please confirm final severance amount (we agreed on 8 weeks) and whether to include outplacement. Michael: please confirm legal is comfortable with the release language Lisa will send.

Attachments: final_offboarding_checklist_20260220.pdf

Thanks — Ava
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, payroll@paycorp.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Immediate offboarding coordination: Samir Rao

Closing the loop: Samir completed the separation meeting at 10:00 AM PST and signed the release via DocuSign. Payroll has been notified (payroll@paycorp.com) and will process the 8-week severance payment on the next payroll cycle; COBRA packet has been triggered. IT revoked Okta/Gmail/AWS credentials at 10:31 AM and collected the laptop at 11:00 AM. Jordan confirmed no outstanding elevated access remained.

I've uploaded the signed release and final checklist to the offboarding folder: https://redwood-drive.internal/docs/offboarding/samir-rao-20260220. Let me know if anyone needs anything else for records or audit.

--
Neha Kapoor
People Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
